vintagekinematics:bore-status-halted: Halted at depth {0}: bit cannot break the block below.
vintagekinematics:bore-halted: Halted: drill bit cannot break the block below.
vintagekinematics:bore-paused: Paused. Open the bore and click Start Drilling to resume.
blockdesc-shaft-*: Carries rotation between machines. Wrap in a frame to pass it through walls and floors.
blockdesc-handcrank-*: Right click to wind. Provides a brief burst of rotation to a small network.
blockdesc-cogwheel-*: Couples two parallel shafts and reverses their direction. Place on the side of a shaft.
blockdesc-largecogwheel-*: Meshes with a small cogwheel on a perpendicular axis to step speed up or down.
blockdesc-gearbox-*: Redirects rotation between any two perpendicular shafts that meet at the corner.
blockdesc-creativemotor-*: Spins forever with no input. Creative use only.
blockdesc-coalmotor-*: Burns coal to spin a connected network. Open the firedoor side to fuel it.
blockdesc-encasedshaft-*: A shaft sleeved in wood so rotation can run through solid blocks.
blockdesc-kineticquern: An auto-quern. Drop grist on top, take flour from the side. Also grinds rock grit into a finer dust that sieves at higher yield with no dead rolls.
blockdesc-crusher-*: The driven head of a crusher pair. Mount above a Crusher Basin and feed it with a shaft. Pulverizes whatever the basin holds.
blockdesc-crusherbasin-*: Holds the item being crushed. Input on top, output from the side or bottom. Crushes raw rock and stones into grit, and graded ore blocks (poor through bountiful) into enriched ore nuggets.
blockdesc-belt-*: Pushes items along while powered. Right click with another belt to chain them.
blockdesc-funnel-copper-*: Pulls items from one side and ejects them out the other. Open to set a filter. 16x slower than the iron funnel and has fewer filter slots.
blockdesc-funnel-iron-*: A faster funnel with more filter slots than the copper version. Pulls items from one side and ejects them out the other. Open to set a filter.
blockdesc-kineticsieve-*: An auto-sieve. Feed it crushed rock (grit or dust), or any vanilla pannable material, to recover sand, ore nuggets and gems. Nuggets must be smelted in a bloomery or forge for usable metal.
blockdesc-kineticsawmill-*: An auto-sawmill. Feed logs in one perpendicular face, collect planks from the opposite perpendicular face (both sides perpendicular to the shaft axle). Cuts while powered.
blockdesc-kineticpress-*: An auto-press. Drop seeds or fruit on top, place a barrel below. Squeezes oil and juice while powered.
blockdesc-kineticbore-*: A heavy industrial drill. Feed it encased shafts and rotation; it descends one block per cycle, leaving a 3x3 shaft behind it.
itemdesc-belt: A leather strap. Place to form a powered conveyor.
itemdesc-crusherframe: A subassembly used to build the crusher.
itemdesc-largecogwheelsection: A subassembly used to build the large cogwheel.
itemdesc-andesite-grit: Crushed andesite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and copper, tin, zinc and iron nuggets. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-basalt-grit: Crushed basalt. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and iron, copper and tin nuggets. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-bauxite-grit: Crushed bauxite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand, flint, copper nuggets and blue clay. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a richer dust.
itemdesc-chalk-grit: Crushed chalk. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and iron, copper, zinc and lead nuggets. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-chert-grit: Crushed chert. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and iron, copper, zinc, lead nuggets and flint. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-claystone-grit: Crushed claystone. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and iron, copper, zinc, lead nuggets and blue clay. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-conglomerate-grit: Crushed conglomerate. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and iron, copper, lead, zinc nuggets and conglomerate gravel. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-granite-grit: Crushed granite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and copper, tin, iron and zinc nuggets. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-kimberlite-grit: Crushed kimberlite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover rough gems (diamond, emerald, peridot) plus chromium, copper, nickel and titanium nuggets. Grind to dust for a richer yield.
itemdesc-limestone-grit: Crushed limestone. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and copper, iron, lead and zinc nuggets. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-marble-grit: Crushed marble. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and copper, iron, gold and silver nuggets. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-meteorite-grit: Crushed meteorite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover meteoric iron bits (direct-smelt to ingot) plus nickel and iron nuggets. Grind to dust for the highest meteoric iron rate.
itemdesc-peridotite-grit: Crushed peridotite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and nickel, chromium, copper, iron and tin nuggets. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-phyllite-grit: Crushed phyllite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and iron, tin, bismuth and copper nuggets. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-shale-grit: Crushed shale. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and iron, copper, zinc and lead nuggets. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
itemdesc-slate-grit: Crushed slate. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and iron, tin, bismuth and copper nuggets. Grind in a Kinetic Quern for a finer dust with no dead rolls.
